key_insight: A deep learning MRI biomarker mapped glioma infiltration beyond contrast-enhancing margins, achieving an independent-test AUC of 0.942.
clinical_relevance: These infiltration maps could help inform surgical planning, radiotherapy targeting, and glioma burden assessment, but clinical benefit remains unproven.
method: Trained a 3D convolutional neural network on multiparametric MRI patches.
Used localized glioma biopsies as ground truth and peritumoral metastasis tissue as non-tumor controls.
Applied patient-level cross-validation, independent testing, and optimized data augmentation.
evidence_signal: In this retrospective study, augmentation optimization increased independent-test accuracy from 74.5% to 85.5% and AUC from 0.859 to 0.942 (reported p = 0.008).
watch_item: Prospective validation across institutions is needed before using these maps to guide treatment.
paper_title: Biopsy-Validated Deep Learning Mapping of Glioma Infiltration Beyond Contrast Enhancement Using Multiparametric MRI
